SEARCH
Package com.j3d.engine.scene.find

Interface Query<T extends SceneObject,V>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of SceneObject this query operates on.
V - The type of the value used for comparison in the query.
All Superinterfaces:
BiFunction<T,V,Boolean>
public interface Query<T extends SceneObject,V> extends BiFunction<T,V,Boolean>
Represents a search query that can be applied to a SceneObject. This functional interface extends BiFunction to define a predicate that takes a SceneObject of type T and a value of type V, returning true if the object matches the query criteria, and false otherwise.

If not using the static predicates defined by Finder this cna be used instead to create a custom search query. Provided it returns true
